answer_1.quote: We conduct our experiments on both math and code tasks. The evaluation on math datasets include Math500 and GSM8K, ... and the coding capability is tested on LiveCodeBench-v1.0.
answer_1.outputs: generated reasoning answers for math problems and code solutions for programming tasks

answer_2.quote: On math tasks, we record the correctness of the answers as the accuracy (Acc.). On code generation benchmark, we report Pass@1 to measure the generation quality.
